content:
**Fried Deerskins** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Radstag skin which has been fried into thin crispy flakes.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Bourbon (1) Radstag Meat (2) Snaptail Reed (2) Thistle (2) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Fried Deerskins | | Fried Deerskins (1) | 

It can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients, after learning the Recipe.
